description: Source code for the CommonTokenStream class implementing TokenStream interface, used for token buffering and filtering in a parser, with licensing and token management methods.

classes.name: CommonTokenStream
classes.description: A class that buffers tokens from a token source, filters tokens by channel and type, and provides token lookahead for parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the token stream with a token source and optional channel.

methods.name: setTokenSource
methods.description: Resets the token source and clears the buffer.

methods.name: fillBuffer
methods.description: Loads all tokens from the source into the buffer, applying channel and discard filters.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Advances the current token pointer, skipping off-channel tokens.

methods.name: skipOffTokenChannels
methods.description: Returns the index of the next on-channel token forward from a given index.

methods.name: skipOffTokenChannelsReverse
methods.description: Returns the index of the next on-channel token backward from a given index.

methods.name: setTokenTypeChannel
methods.description: Overrides the channel for tokens of a specific type.

methods.name: discardTokenType
methods.description: Marks tokens of a specific type to be discarded.

methods.name: discardOffChannelTokens
methods.description: Sets whether to discard tokens on off channels.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Returns the list of buffered tokens, filling buffer if necessary.

methods.name: getTokensBetween
methods.description: Returns tokens between specified indices.

methods.name: getTokensOfTypeInSet
methods.description: Returns tokens of specific types within a range.

methods.name: getTokensOfTypeInArray
methods.description: Returns tokens of specific types within a range, using an array of types.

methods.name: getTokensofType
methods.description: Returns tokens of a specific type within a range.

methods.name: LT
methods.description: Returns the token at a lookahead position, skipping off-channel tokens.

methods.name: LB
methods.description: Returns the token at a lookbehind position, skipping off-channel tokens.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the token at a specific index.

methods.name: LA
methods.description: Returns the type of the token at a lookahead position.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks the current position in the token stream.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a marker (no operation).

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of tokens in the buffer.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the current token index.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to a previous marker or last position.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the token pointer to the start.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current token index.

methods.name: getTokenSource
methods.description: Returns the token source.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the source name from the token source.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token stream.

methods.name: toStringBetween
methods.description: Returns a string of tokens between two indices.

methods.name: toStringBetweenTokens
methods.description: Returns a string between two tokens.
